company_name: Shandong Chief Fluoride New Materials Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company produces high-purity fluoride materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes such as etching and cleaning.
summary: Shandong Chief Fluoride New Materials Co., Ltd specializes in producing high-purity fluoride materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products, including fluorinated gases and specialty chemicals, are used in semiconductor device fabrication processes like etching and cleaning.
technical_expertise: Chemical synthesis of high-purity fluoride materials

regional_presence.China: Located in the Gaoqing Chemical Industrial Park, Zibo City, Shandong Province, with plans to enhance production capabilities.
